第7章 月下练剑九阳焚天（第1页）
叶凡一个激灵，连忙后退两步，“姐姐，我突然想起家里还有点急事，怕是不能再陪您了……”
苏媚娘轻唤一声，却并未阻拦，看着叶凡仓皇逃窜的背影，嘴角勾起一抹玩味笑意，“有意思的小子，居然能得到曜日剑的认可……”
曜日剑，当年是她师尊留在万宝楼的。
她师尊从哪里得来此剑，并未细说。
但她知道，此剑绝非玄阶上品这么简单。
“哟，这不是叶凡吗？这么快就出来了？”
“第一次嘛，快了点也正常，没被榨干就该偷着乐了。”
“看他那狼狈样，笑死人了。不过就算逃出万宝楼，能逃出苏媚娘的手掌心吗？”
万宝楼外还没散去的几人，发出一阵哄笑。
叶凡回到叶府，二话不说冲进自己的小院。
从屋内搬出一张躺椅，惬意地躺了下来。
随着太阳西沉，修为突破到灵武境四阶。
叶凡伸了个懒腰，忍不住吐槽，“不过这修为进阶的速度，好像越来越慢了。”
一年之内，他必须进阶玄武境七阶。
叶凡抬头望向刚刚升起的月亮，眼睛一亮，“月光也是光，不知道效果如何？”
月光如水般洒落，却没有转化为灵力。

但他忽然感觉，脑子好像清醒了不少。
叶凡兴奋地取出曜日剑，“吸收月光涨悟性，月下练剑，事半功倍啊！”
正当他翻找武技时，识海深处的镇天碑一阵颤动。
须臾后，就被一股神秘力量拉入了一个奇异空间。
虚空中，赫然写着三个大字——镇天界。
镇天碑的秘密，太阳神帝都没搞清楚。
他感觉，镇天界内时间流速与外界不同。
此地虽无灵气，修炼武技亦不消耗灵力。
如今身在外界吸收月光增强悟性，意识入镇天界内修炼武技，倒是绝配。
叶凡毫不犹豫，立马挥剑开始演练。
无数次挥剑过后，空间毫无征兆的波动。
“怎么回事？难道在镇天界内修炼武技，还有时间限制？”

Chapter 7 Sword practice under the moon Nine Suns Burn the Sky (Page 1)
Ye Fan was startled and quickly took two steps back, "Sister, I suddenly remembered that there is something urgent at home. I'm afraid I won't be able to accompany you anymore..."
Su Meiniang called out softly, but did not stop her. Looking at Ye Fan's hastily escaping back, a playful smile appeared at the corner of her mouth, "What an interesting boy, he can actually be recognized by the Yaori Sword..."
The Yaori Sword was left by her master in Wanbao Tower.
Where her master got this sword did not go into detail.
But she knew that this sword was by no means as simple as a high-grade Xuan-level sword.
"Hey, isn't this Mark Ye? Come out so soon?"
"It's the first time. It's normal that it's a little faster. You should have some fun without being squeezed dry."
"Looking at his embarrassment, it makes people laugh to death. But even if he escapes from Wanbao Tower, can he escape from Su Meiniang's hands?"
The few people who had not dispersed outside Wanbao Building burst into laughter.
Ye Fan returned to Ye Mansion and rushed into his small courtyard without saying a word.
He brought a deck chair out of the house and lay down comfortably.
As the sun sets in the west, the cultivation level breaks through to the fourth level of Lingwu Realm.
Ye Fan stretched out and couldn't help complaining, "But the speed of this cultivation level seems to be getting slower and slower."
Within a year, he must advance to the seventh level of Xuanwu Realm.
Ye Fan looked up at the moon that had just risen, his eyes lit up, "Moonlight is also light, I wonder what the effect is?"
The moonlight fell like water, but it was not converted into spiritual power.
But he suddenly felt that his mind seemed to be much clearer.
Ye Fan excitedly took out the Sunlight Sword, "Absorb the moonlight to increase your understanding, practice swordsmanship under the moon, you will get twice the result with half the effort!"
Just as he was searching for martial arts, the Heaven-Suppressing Monument deep in the sea of ​​consciousness trembled.
A moment later, he was pulled into a strange space by a mysterious force.
In the void, three big characters were written - Heaven-Suppressing Realm.
Even the Sun God Emperor didn’t even figure out the secret of the Sky-Suppressing Monument.
He felt that the speed of time in Zhentian Realm was different from that in the outside world.
Although there is no spiritual energy here, practicing martial arts does not consume spiritual energy.
Now he is in the outside world, absorbing moonlight to enhance his understanding, and his consciousness is in the Heaven-Suppressing Realm to practice martial arts, which is a perfect match.
Ye Fan did not hesitate and immediately started practicing with his sword.
After swinging the sword countless times, the space fluctuated without warning.
"What's going on? Is there a time limit for practicing martial arts in the Tianzhen Realm?"
